name: codex-sync
description: Privately share user-authored Codex skills, rules, instructions, and optional memories between Macs with reviewed plans, receipts, and snapshots.

interface.shortDescription: Private, plan-bound Codex sync between Macs
interface.longDescription: Share user-authored Codex skills, rules, instructions, and optional memories through your own private shared folder. Store identity, reviewed Plan IDs, handoff receipts, snapshots, conflict preservation, and strict exclusions protect each transfer; no synchronized content is sent to the developer.
defaultPrompt: Create a Codex Sync Store in my private shared folder and show me its Store ID.
Join my existing Codex Sync Store only if its Store ID matches.
Show status as JSON, explain the plan, and apply only the approved Plan ID.
Verify the previous Mac's receipt before syncing this Mac.
Show snapshot history and preview a restore without changing files.
